## Professional Summary
Gowri Prasath Shanmugasundaram is a Senior Software Developer with over 4.5 years of industry experience across banking, capital markets, and high-availability enterprise environments. Proven track record of architecting concurrent Golang microservices, engineering real-time data streaming pipelines, and modernizing legacy monoliths into cloud-native, WCAG-compliant Angular applications.

## Core Technical Competencies
- Backend & Microservices: Go (Golang), Java (Spring Boot, Struts), Node.js, RESTful APIs, gRPC, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets
- Frontend & Architecture: Angular (v8 through v20), TypeScript, RxJS, Angular Signals, HTML5/CSS3, AODA / WCAG AA Accessibility
- Cloud & Containerization: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Microsoft Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104 prep), BytePlus
- Databases & Messaging: Azure SQL, Oracle SQL, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure Blob Storage, Solace Queue
- DevSecOps & Testing: Azure CI/CD Pipelines, Jenkins, Snyk (SAST/SCA/DAST), Aqua, Black Duck, Jasmine, Karma, Playwright, Vitest

## Key Experience
- Programmer at Kumaran Systems (Sept 2022 - Present) | Chennai, India
  - Led migration of legacy Java & Java Struts monoliths to Golang microservices and modern Angular architectures.
  - Architected high-throughput microservices using Golang concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels).
  - Built real-time market data streaming pipelines using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and Refinitiv (LSEG) WebSocket APIs.
  - Upgraded enterprise Angular applications from v8/9 to v17/18/20.
  - Containerized and deployed 10+ business-critical microservices onto OpenShift using Helm charts and automated Azure CI/CD pipelines.

## Notable Projects & Open Source
- go-gmail (Open Source Go Library): Fluent, rate-limited Go wrapper for the Gmail API (https://github.com/gowriprasathdev/go-gmail).
- CDR (Canadian Depositary Receipts): High-availability capital markets system handling real-time market pricing and corporate action voting.
- OII (Online Insurance Inquiry): Enterprise insurance advisory platform modernized to Golang microservices with secure mTLS integrations.
- Securitization Platform: Enterprise ABCP debt operations platform built with Go, Angular Signals, and Solace messaging.
- CWF (Common Web Framework): Reusable enterprise Angular UI framework enforcing strict WCAG AA accessibility standards.
